name: zmax-gui
description: zmax-gui — desktop GUI wrapper around the zmax editor (Helix fork). Runs the zmax binary in an embedded PTY terminal with the shared zgui-core baseline.

scripts.dev: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri dev
scripts.build: pnpm install && node scripts/copy-embed-terminal.mjs && tauri build
